scope: Causal profiling comparison for the retained matrix-offset i32 narrowing only. Baseline means the prior final epilogue-optimized binary; later guard/factoring probes are excluded.
conclusion: The narrowing changes the causal matrix-load schedule and eliminates the previously large observed HMMA short-scoreboard sample population in both measured modes. SASS load/use distances and the exploratory timing comparison support restored load overlap as the main mechanism; integer-instruction reduction alone is substantially smaller. Zero observed samples is not proof of zero actual stalls.

method.hardware: RTX5090, SM120a; physical GPU1 selected by CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
method.profiling: Nsight Compute SourceCounters, cache-control none, clock-control none, warp-sampling-interval0; one measured launch after correctness/warmup. Exact commands retained below.
method.instruction_counts: Sum Instructions Executed across PCs, checked against smsp__inst_executed.sum. These are dynamic warp-instruction counts.
method.phase_identification: 128 static HMMA instructions grouped as firstQK32, firstPV32, steadyQK32, steadyPV32. Physical schedule regions bounded by first preceding LDSM/final HMMA; interleaving prevents treating these as pure source phases.
method.normalization: Stalls expressed as observed counts, share of all samples in the same profile, and samples per1000 dynamic instructions in that phase. Not cycle/time estimates.
method.timing: Separate Nsight Systems kernel-active durations. The retained narrow-only probe and fresh baseline each contain one round with31 measured launches and100 warmup launches. Exploratory evidence; not final repeated benchmark results.

caveats: Zero observed short-scoreboard samples does not guarantee zero short-scoreboard stalls.
One sampled launch per profile; sampling is stochastic. Stall categories can shift without proportional changes in elapsed time.
Math samples rise as short-scoreboard samples fall. These category changes cannot be added as independent time savings.
Nsight Compute duration/replay duration is excluded from performance conclusions.
The preliminary timing comparisons have only one round and should not replace final repeated measurements. Paired references also vary slightly between probes.
Register counts increase after narrowing. The evidence supports improved operand allocation/scheduling, not a claim that reducing register count improved occupancy.
The128CTA grid is smaller than the170SM GPU. Theoretical blocks-per-SM occupancy differences do not establish a residency bottleneck here.
This comparison isolates matrix-offset narrowing; it says nothing about subsequent guard/factoring probes.

load_use_audit.definition: near_use_count counts QK LDSM whose first HMMA consumer is separated by at most one intervening instruction. Instruction distance is not cycle latency.

proof_review.review_result: No blocking soundness or ABI issue found in the reviewed narrowing. This is a reasoned code review, not a machine-checked proof.
proof_review.scope: MatrixTranslation::matrix_offset_fits_i32 and typed Emitter index/composed changes; CopyTranslation and unsafe load_matrix_* contracts.
assumptions: CuteLdmatrixOp verification runs before translation and verifies layout/operand structure, positive extents and byte-layout loadability.
Unsafe load_matrix_* callers provide their hardware lane in 0..32 and a complete selected 16x16 or 16x8 window inside the logical shared tile.
Source pointer capacity, alignment, correct address space and convergent warp participation remain caller-owned unsafe contracts.
argument: The positive logical shape product is at most i32::MAX. Each top-level mode size and nested leaf extent is positive and no larger than this product. A valid full window therefore bounds window origins, row/column expansions and every nested digit before truncation.

Offset and each stride are individually nonnegative and at most i32::MAX. The checked sum offset + sum((extent-1)*stride) is at most i32::MAX. With nonnegative terms, this bounds each multiplication and every partial sum, avoiding cancellation-based false proofs.

Both swizzle source and destination masks exclude bit31 and higher. Masking, shifting and XOR therefore preserve the nonnegative i32 range. For nonempty valid fields this also bounds the shift distance below32; empty-field swizzles return before any shift.

The narrow offset is zero-extended to i64 before the existing pointer GEP. The base pointer is never truncated. Negative offsets/strides, oversized logical shapes/offsets, or sign-bit swizzles select the existing i64 path.
The operation operand/result contract, NVVM ldmatrix count/transpose selection, i32 fragment extraction and 64-bit fragment-slot indexing remain unchanged.

CopyTranslation is byte-identical in the production snapshots. Its index/composed inputs remain i64, so the generalized helpers instantiate their previous 64-bit constants and arithmetic. Global-copy bounds and zero-fill behavior are unchanged.
proof_review.test_review: Tests cover bound decisions and emitted-address equivalence across roles, every window/lane of representative nested/negative/high-offset layouts, and a base pointer above32bits. These examples support regression detection; they do not establish the universal arithmetic argument.
